# Capability matrix

Which features each flavour offers. The running server reports the same data for its own flavour at `GET /api/capabilities`. Source: `internal/capabilities`. In the Cluster flavour every feature is `preview` until it has been verified in production-like operation.

| Feature | Maturity | Community single-tenant (`single`) | Community multi-tenant (`multi`) | Cluster (`cluster`) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `column_encryption`: Per-tenant column encryption of personal data, names, settings and audit text | stable | yes | yes | yes |
| `database_import`: Restore a database backup from Admin → Backups | stable | yes | no: the import swaps the whole database and restarts the process; a tenant is restored by the platform operator | no: the import swaps the whole database and restarts the process; a tenant is restored by the platform operator |
| `external_kms`: Key encryption key in an external KMS or HSM | preview | no: not planned: the key encryption key is a key file or a tenant-supplied key | no: not planned: the key encryption key is a key file or a tenant-supplied key | no: not planned: the key encryption key is a key file or a tenant-supplied key |
| `horizontal_scaling`: Several web replicas serving every tenant | preview | no: needs the Cluster coordinator (Kubernetes Lease, shared job table) | no: needs the Cluster coordinator (Kubernetes Lease, shared job table) | yes |
| `in_app_restart`: Orderly restart from the admin screens | stable | yes | yes | no: meaningless with several replicas and an external database |
| `journal_anchors`: Independent journal and WORM anchors for the control log and the audit chain | preview | no: not planned: no independent journal or WORM anchors; any future journal must be encrypted | no: not planned: no independent journal or WORM anchors; any future journal must be encrypted | no: not planned: no independent journal or WORM anchors; any future journal must be encrypted |
| `key_management_ui`: Admin → Keys: key status, rotation, retirement and the tenant-managed key (Cluster) | preview | yes | yes | yes |
| `key_rotation`: Tenant administrators rotate the data, files, index, secrets and audit-enc keys (API and sendora-db) | stable | yes | yes | yes |
| `master_key_rotation`: The platform operator rotates the versioned master key; every tenant's key encryption key follows (Key management in the platform console) | preview | no: only in the Cluster flavour (versioned master key on the controllers) | no: only in the Cluster flavour (versioned master key on the controllers) | yes |
| `multi_tenant_conversion`: Convert to multi-tenant from Admin → Multi-tenant | stable | yes | no: only in the single-tenant flavour | no: needs the SQLite database of the Community flavours |
| `object_storage`: Share files in S3, Azure Blob or Google Cloud Storage | stable | yes | yes | yes |
| `operator_key_rotation`: The platform operator forces a rotation of the data keys of one or all platform-managed tenants (Key management in the platform console) | stable | no: needs a multi-tenant flavour (multi or cluster) | yes | yes |
| `pitr`: Point-in-time recovery of the database cluster (CloudNativePG and Barman, set up by the operator; not exercised by the project's tests) | preview | no: needs CloudNativePG point-in-time recovery (Cluster flavour) | no: needs CloudNativePG point-in-time recovery (Cluster flavour) | yes |
| `platform_console`: Platform console managing many tenants | stable | no: needs a multi-tenant flavour (multi or cluster) | yes | yes |
| `rwx_storage`: Shared Kubernetes volume (NFS, CephFS, …) as storage location | preview | no: needs the shared-volume (RWX) storage backend of the Cluster flavour | no: needs the shared-volume (RWX) storage backend of the Cluster flavour | yes |
| `shares`: Encrypted shares, reverse shares and downloads | stable | yes | yes | yes |
| `tenant_managed_kek`: A tenant uploads its own key encryption key; locked state after a controller restart | preview | no: only in the Cluster flavour (needs the controller key endpoint) | no: only in the Cluster flavour (needs the controller key endpoint) | yes |

Adapter capabilities per flavour:

- **Community single-tenant**: `keys.management_ui`, `process.single_replica`, `store.sqlite`, `tenancy.single`
- **Community multi-tenant**: `keys.management_ui`, `process.single_replica`, `store.sqlite`, `tenancy.multi`
- **Cluster**: `coordinator.multi_replica`, `filestore.rwx`, `keys.management_ui`, `keys.master_rotation`, `keys.tenant_managed_kek`, `store.pitr_per_cluster`, `store.postgres`, `tenancy.multi`
